The Biographical Record
London, England  ·  Est. 1976  ·  A Life in Full
Benedict
Cumberbatch
From the fog of London to the dimensions of the strange — relentlessly, brilliantly human.
Born into a theatrical household in Hammersmith, he walked the boards of Harrow, the corridors of RADA, and the stages of the West End before the world knew his name. Patience was his craft. The work, his answer.
Sherlock. Turing. Strange. Each role a different universe — each one unmistakably the same man. CBE. BAFTA. Hamlet at the Barbican, sold out in minutes. History, one life at a time.
History, one life at a time.
